title: Glessner's north tower checked against two old photographs
items: Nothing you can see moved. One 1965 photograph put the tip of the round tower's cone about 2 ft from where the model has it, which would need a wider tower. A second photograph, and the outline of the cone in both, say the tower is right where it stands, and that the first photograph's camera position was what was off. The tower stays as built, and a check now keeps it there.
